subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: What subset of this WebChat conversation-management and multi-AI collaboration request should OpenClaw core own first?
rationale: The remaining work crosses product UX, session storage/protocol, WebChat/Control UI, and agent orchestration boundaries, and VISION.md cautions against heavy orchestration layers as a default architecture.

options.title: Split Into Milestones
options.body: Keep this canonical tracker and create or route smaller owner-reviewed milestones for project/session organization, WebChat UI, and collaboration semantics.

options.title: Narrow To Session Organization
options.body: Explicitly scope core work to directory/category/search/pin/archive UX and defer committee-style collaboration to plugins or later design.

options.title: Reject Heavy Collaboration Layer
options.body: Close or trim the committee/meeting/project-tracking portions if maintainers decide they conflict with current core-slimming guardrails.

recommendation.title: Split Into Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this canonical tracker and create or route smaller owner-reviewed milestones for project/session organization, WebChat UI, and collaboration semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the canonical tracker signal and authored the recent broad session controls foundation, making him the best available owner for product direction.
